Website information

Privacy

This website provides clinic information and links for arranging a visit.

Appointment requests

The appointment page prepares a WhatsApp link on your device. This website does not submit or store the request. When you choose to send a message, WhatsApp and the clinic handle it through that service.

External services

Google Maps, Instagram, Threads and Google Fonts are external services. They apply their own privacy terms. For questions about clinic records or messages, contact the clinic directly.
